description:
You are the Data Manager for Bo District. The Directorate of Planning wants to compare malaria caseloads between Urban and Rural facilities to allocate bed nets effectively. 

Using DHIS2 (http://localhost:8080, admin/district), perform the following configuration and analysis:

1. Create two new Organisation Unit Groups named 'Urban Facilities' and 'Rural Facilities'.
2. Create a new Organisation Unit Group Set named 'Facility Location' containing these two groups. Ensure this Group Set is enabled as a 'Data dimension' so it can be used in reports.
3. Assign 'Bo Gov Hospital' to the 'Urban Facilities' group.
4. Assign 'Ngelehun CHC' to the 'Rural Facilities' group.
5. Run the Analytics Tables (Resource Tables) generation to update the system dimensions.
6. Create a bar/column chart in the Data Visualizer showing 'Malaria treated' (or a similar malaria indicator) for 'Bo District' for the year 2023. Break down the data by your new 'Facility Location' dimension. 
7. Save this visualization as 'Bo Urban vs Rural Malaria 2023'.

metadata.task_focus: metadata configuration and custom dimension analysis
